$meta.name: Silver Mirror
$meta.direction: Silver Mirror: pearl and lavender-silver surfaces, liquid-silver brand sheen, deep slate pills, greige warmth, a designed graphite dark
$meta.lineage: Replaces Clay & Ink v1.1 (archived in design/system/directions/). Same three layers and the same component keys, so the app re-skins without code changes; new roles are additive. Product law kept: CAUTION never red, UNKNOWN never an error, MEDICINE is ink only, colour never alone, 48dp targets, 12dp type floor.
$meta.units: All sizes are dp (React Native density-independent px). CSS output converts 1dp = 1px. letterSpacing is in dp, as React Native expects; CSS output also gives em.

aliasSyntax.{color.text}: semantic colour in the active mode (semantic.color.<mode>.<path>)

tuningHistory: v2.0 Silver Mirror (2026-11-02). Source: design/reference/silver-mirror-moodboard.md (Aman's moodboard), critique-current.md and dribbble-patterns.md.

Neutrals are one cool ramp with a faint lavender cast (hue about 250 degrees, saturation under 12%): pearl (light surfaces), silver (mid greys, text levels), graphite (dark surfaces). No warm/cool mixing inside a theme.

Primary = deep slate #3B3F52 pill with pearl label (9.6:1). Dark primary is inverted: pearl #F6F5F8 pill with slate #2F3243 label (10.9:1), so the one action per screen is the brightest object in a graphite room.

UNKNOWN head is pearl/graphite neutral with a dashed slate edge, not a slate fill, so it can never be mistaken for the slate primary pill (critique S10 / 5.3). FITS = muted sage, CAUTION = soft amber (hue 37-39 degrees in every role), MEDICINE = ink outline only.
Greige #CFC4BB is a fill only (1.6:1 on pearl): Demo-reading badge, focus tiles. Never text, never a meaningful edge.

Dark theme is graphite #121319 with surfaces stepping lighter (#1A1B23, #20212A), a lavender-silver sheen gradient on hero zones and a 1dp top highlight on raised cards. No shadows in dark; elevation is tone.

Type: Noto Serif Display (high-contrast, has the rupee sign) for the wordmark, display and title only, never below 20dp. Geist (has the rupee sign, tabular figures) for every control, label, reason and body line.
Paper grain retired (opacity 0 in both modes); depth now comes from soft slate-tinted offset shadows in light and tone steps in dark.
Icon stroke 1.5 (moodboard thin line); active tab 2.0 so selection is stroke + weight + pill, never colour alone.
$meta.sourceOfTruth: This file. theme.ts and tokens.css are generated by build-tokens.mjs; check-contrast.mjs gates every pair. Do not hand-edit the outputs.

pearl.$description: Light surfaces. Cool off-white with a faint lavender cast (moodboard #F6F5F8).

silver.$description: Mid greys from the same cool ramp: secondary text levels and meaningful edges.

graphite.$description: Dark theme surfaces and light-theme ink. Deep slate-graphite, never pure black.

slate.$description: Deep slate navy (moodboard #3B3F52): primary pills, the active tab, links, focus. UNKNOWN uses it only for its icon, label and dashed edge. 'shadow' tints light-mode elevation.

lavender.$description: Low-saturation lavender-silver: icon discs, the dark focus ring, the brand sheen. Kept under 30% saturation (no 'AI purple').

greige.$description: Warm greige/taupe (moodboard #CFC4BB). A fill only: badges and focus tiles. Never text on pearl, never a meaningful edge.

chrome.$description: Liquid-silver gradient stops for the brand mark and the pearl hero. Decorative only; never carries text contrast on its own.

sage.$description: FITS. Muted sage-teal, far from the slate accent's hue.

amber.$description: CAUTION. Soft amber, hue 37-39 degrees in every step. Never red, never an alarm.

$notes.border: Decorative hairline (dividers, card edges). Never the only edge of a control; not gated under WCAG 1.4.11.
$notes.border-strong: Edges that carry meaning: inputs, empty meter segments, sheet handle, pending step ring. Gated at 3:1 on every surface.
$notes.text-subtle: Third text level (timestamps, helper text). Still gated at 4.5:1 on every surface it can sit on.
$notes.accent: Light: deep slate #3B3F52 pill with pearl label. Dark: inverted, pearl #F6F5F8 pill with slate #2F3243 label. One filled primary per screen state.
$notes.secondary-bg: Soft tonal pill for secondary actions (moodboard's translucent pill, made solid so contrast is measurable). No outline.
$notes.accent-warm: Greige fill for the Demo-reading badge and focus tiles. Its label is on-accent-warm; greige is never text on pearl.
$notes.icon-disc: Lavender circle behind a 1.5-stroke line icon (moodboard droplet disc): reading card, empty states, consent rows.
$notes.bracket: Corner-bracket stroke for the face frame illustration on pearl or graphite. Over the live camera use on-overlay instead.
$notes.sheen: Hero gradient stops (top-left start to bottom end, lavender band at 40%). Body text may sit on any stop (gated).
$notes.mark: Brand tile and chrome-S gradient stops. Decorative; the wordmark next to the mark carries the name.
$notes.sheen-edge: Dark only: a 1dp top highlight on raised cards and sheets, the 'silver sheen' that keeps dark from reading flat black. Transparent in light.
$notes.focus-ring: 2dp outline, 2dp offset, drawn over the surrounding surface. Dark uses lavender so it reads around the pearl pill.
$notes.verdict: bg/fg/border/icon apply to the verdict HEAD only. Reasons sit on the plain surface. 1dp edge (dashed for UNKNOWN and name-only), gated at 3:1. No leading stripe.
$notes.verdict.medicine: Not a box: fill equals the screen bg and the component draws no border. Pharmacist icon at 32dp, one serif line, no verdict label. Not an alarm.
$notes.verdict.unknown: Neutral pearl / graphite fill with a dashed slate edge and the dashed-circle icon. Never a slate fill: that is the primary pill.
$notes.meter: Neutral ink only, never accent. Empty segments are a full-opacity 1dp border-strong outline (>=3:1).
$notes.overlay-camera: Dims the live camera around the capture frame. Gated for on-overlay text over a worst-case white frame.
$notes.qr: QR is always black modules on a white field in both modes, for scanner reliability (the only pure black in the system).
$notes.error: Silver Mirror has no red. Errors are neutral: icon + text + 2dp text-colour field border. CAUTION is never an error colour.

serif.name: Noto Serif Display
serif.role: Wordmark (outlined SVG), screen display titles, the product name on /check, the verdict sentence. Never below 20dp.
serif.opticalSizing: Display cut: hairlines are fine by design, so the face is held at 20dp and up. Web: load wght 400..500 from Google Fonts.

sans.name: Geist
sans.role: Everything you operate or scan: controls, labels, section heads, reasons, body, fine print, numbers (tabular figures).

expoFonts.$coverage: Both faces contain U+20B9 INDIAN RUPEE SIGN (verified with fontTools on the build VM, 2026-11-02).

display.use: Home greeting, welcome headline, empty-state headline

title.use: Product title on /check, screen titles, the medicine-gate line

headline.use: Card heads, sheet titles, 'Where this comes from', empty-state sentence

verdictLine.use: The verdict sentence under the label, one unit in one style

section.use: Sentence-case section heads: 'Why · 2 reasons', 'What stays on this phone', 'Better matches'

reason.use: Reason reading line. Out-sizes the 15dp verdict label (P1: reasons before verdicts).

reasonIndex.use: Step numbers where order matters (share steps). Not decoration on candidates or matches.

figure.use: QR countdown ('29 min left'), catalogue count on /how

verdictLabel.use: FITS / CAUTION / UNKNOWN, with a 24dp icon in a disc. Never truncates; wraps at max font scale.

body.use: Body copy, the product fact in each reason (full text colour), consent body

bodyStrong.use: Band value (High), emphasised step, list row title

bodySm.use: Ledger values, supporting lines, card secondary text

label.use: Chip and band names, field labels, snackbar action

labelSmRegular.use: Unselected tab label (selection is weight + stroke + pill, never colour alone)

overline.use: Ledger keys only (Reading / Product / Rules / Limits), sentence case. The name is historical: no tracked caps, no eyebrows.

caption.use: Destination lines, disclosures, meter labels (Low / Medium / High), timestamps

fine.use: Data credits only (Open-Meteo CC BY 4.0, Open Beauty Facts ODbL). The floor: nothing is smaller than 12.

rules.numerals: Dates, prices (₹), SPF, counts and step numbers use tabular figures (RN fontVariant ['tabular-nums'], CSS font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).
rules.android: includeFontPadding: false; textAlignVertical: 'center' on single-line labels. Do not set fontWeight on custom families in React Native: the weight is baked into the family key (Geist_600SemiBold).
rules.fontScaling: allowFontScaling stays on and maxFontSizeMultiplier is 2.0 on every style (theme.ts textProps). Layouts reflow at 2.0x: buttons stack at 1.3x, ledger keys stack and the sticky action bar becomes inline at 1.5x, tab labels wrap to 2 lines. Verdict labels and reasons never truncate (no numberOfLines).
rules.serifUse: Serif = wordmark, display, title, the product name and the verdict sentence. Everything else is Geist. Never serif below 20dp.
rules.web: tokens.css sets font sizes in rem (16px root) and unitless line heights, so the browser text-size setting scales type without clipping. Spacing stays px.

$usage.md: focus tiles, snackbars, thumbnails, the icon tile
$usage.lg: cards, verdict head, ledger, reading card, checklist card
$usage.full: every button (pills), chips, fields, icon buttons, tab indicator

elevation.$approach: Light: pearl stack (bg-sunken < bg < surface < surface-raised white) plus one soft slate-tinted offset shadow, never pure black, never a zero-offset halo. Dark: tone steps, a hairline and a 1dp sheen-edge on top; no shadows.

1.use: Cards on bg: reading card, product cards, checklist card, share tip

2.use: Sticky action dock once content scrolls under it, tab bar (shadow casts upward)

3.use: Sheets and snackbars get a border-strong edge and the sheen-edge highlight instead of a shadow

motion.$personality: Mirror settling: light glides across and comes to rest. Decelerating, no springs, no overshoot, nothing loops.

glide.use: The one authored moment: face-frame brackets closing in as each scan step completes (exponential ease-out)

linear.use: QR countdown rule and determinate progress only

enter.$use: Reason stagger translateY and verdict reveal / press scale start values

timing.$rule: Android: pass durations through AccessibilityInfo.getRecommendedTimeoutMillis. While TalkBack is on, a snackbar with an action stays until dismissed.

patterns.press: bg to state.pressed (or accent-pressed) in {duration.press}; scale 0.98 as a transform only, so layout never shifts. Android: ripple in state.ripple.
patterns.verdictReveal: opacity 0 to 1 and scale 0.98 to 1 over {duration.verdictReveal}, ease decelerate. One light haptic tick when the verdict lands; no extra haptic on CAUTION.
patterns.reasons: opacity 0 to 1 and translateY 6dp to 0, {duration.reasonStagger} stagger, max 3 items
patterns.processingStep: Each tick draws once in {duration.stepTick}. The current step is a static ring with a centre dot; no spinner loop.
patterns.bracketResolve: On each completed scan step the four face-frame brackets move 4dp toward the centre over {duration.bracketResolve} with ease glide; after 'Deleted from YouCam' they settle closed. The single signature moment.
patterns.sheet: translateY from 100% with {ease.decelerate}, scrim fades in over {duration.state}

reducedMotion.rule: Every transition becomes an opacity crossfade of {duration.crossfade}. No translate, no scale, no stagger, brackets jump to their end position. Step ticks appear without drawing.

forbidden: shimmer sweeps on the mark or text

touch.$rule: Every tappable element is a Pressable whose own box is at least 48 x 48dp, reached with minHeight/minWidth plus padding. hitSlop only where the parent already has 48dp of room. Never a nested <Text onPress> for an action.

icon.library: Custom SVG line icons (react-native-svg) on a 24dp grid, 1.5 stroke, round caps and joins. Lucide shapes may be redrawn as reference; no filled glyph sets, no emoji, no unicode ticks.

fits.meaning: Scalloped seal with a check. The only non-circular verdict silhouette.

caution.meaning: Partly fits. Never a triangle, never an exclamation mark.

unknown.meaning: Incomplete information. Not an error glyph.

medicine.lucide: custom: head and shoulders behind a counter, one small bottle standing on the counter, 1.5 stroke; reads at 20dp
medicine.meaning: Ask the pharmacist. No cross, no plus, no pill, no mortar and pestle, no alert.

avoid: share/upload glyph for provenance ('Shared from' uses arrow-down-left)

grain.tile: assets/texture/grain-160.png (static tile, retired in Silver Mirror: opacity 0 in both modes; kept so the theme shape is stable)
forbidden: everywhere in Silver Mirror (depth comes from sheen gradients and soft shadows)

sheen.$rule: The liquid-silver sheen is a static SVG linear gradient (color.sheen.start -> lavender at 40% -> silver at 72% -> end), top-left to bottom-right, plus at most one soft radial highlight. Allowed: splash, welcome, Home hero band, empty-state plates, the reading card header strip, the capture/processing face frame. Never behind reasons, the ledger, forms or the verdict head. Never animated.

zIndex.$rn: On Android, elevation also orders siblings; set elevation alongside zIndex for sheets and snackbars.

focus.$rule: One focus recipe for every control. Measured against the surface around the control, not its fill.

brand.$rule: Chrome-S mark (SVG, apps/mobile/src/brand/SilverMark.tsx) on its tile, and the outlined serif wordmark (Wordmark.tsx). wordmarkHeader / wordmarkWelcome are cap heights in dp. The mark never sits on the verdict head or over the camera. Minimum mark size 24dp; clear space = 25% of the tile on every side.

button.$rule: Every button is a pill (radius.full). Hierarchy: primary = filled slate (pearl in dark), at most one per screen state; secondary = tonal pill, no outline; tertiary = text with a chevron. Outlined boxes are retired.

destructiveNeutral.$rule: Delete my reading, Withdraw consent, Revoke. No red and no box: a text-style pill with a leading trash icon and a verb label, always followed by a confirmation sheet.

consentPair.$rule: Start scan / Not now on every consent screen: identical tonal pill, size and type (spec §2: equal visual weight), so declining is never the weaker-looking choice. Product law beats the critique's slate-pill suggestion here.

actionBar.$rule: Sticky dock on /check: ONE primary pill naming its destination ('Back to Nykaa listing'), plus a 48dp round tonal 'More' button that opens the store-search sheet. 'Better matches' pill hides once that section is on screen. Border-top and elevation.2 appear only while content scrolls under it. Rendered after the ScrollView so TalkBack reaches it last. At font scale >= 1.5 the actions move inline.

textLink.$rule: Standalone links are Pressables with a 48dp box. Inline links inside a sentence exist on the web only; in RN the action moves to its own row.

productHeader.$rule: Title and meta are one header node; the Edit link is a sibling rendered after it. The store is a small source chip ('Flipkart'), text only. No 'Is this the product?' kicker once the SKU sheet confirmed it.
productHeader.title: {type.title}

field.$rule: Rounded filled pill field with a visible 1dp edge (>=3:1) and an inline trailing action pill inside it ('Check'). Label above, helper and error below.
field.label: {type.label}

chip.$rule: Filter and reading chips (moodboard 'Key Concerns' / 'For You'). Pills. Selected = slate fill + check icon + weight, never colour alone. Static reading chips are read inline with their card.

iconDisc.$rule: A line icon centred in a lavender disc (moodboard droplet circle). One per card, decorative (hidden from TalkBack).

medicineGate.$rule: No box, no label, no reasons, no ledger, no matches. The 32dp pharmacist icon sits above one serif line, about a third of the way down the content area. One action: Back to product.

nameOnly.$rule: FITS or CAUTION head colours with a dashed border and the qualifier 'based on product name only' inside the label node.

body.$rule: Reasons sit on the plain screen surface. The verdict tint never extends past the head, and CAUTION never fills the screen.

bandChip.$rule: Compact pill inside a reason row or reading card: text first, the meter only repeats it. Non-interactive by default; the interactive variant is a Pressable with a 48dp box around the 32dp visual.

bandList.$rule: Reading bands as rows inside a rounded surface card with hairline dividers. Name on the left (sans), band word on the right (sans semibold) with the neutral three-segment meter under it. One Low / Medium / High legend above the list. No numbers.
bandList.name: {type.body}

tag.$rule: Static tags are not tappable and are read inline with their parent. Anything tappable is a chip or a text link.

skinMap.$rule: Photo-free zone diagram traced from YouCam masks. No photo, no skin colour. Band = hatch density (none Low, single 45 degree hatch Medium, cross-hatch High), never fill lightness. Every zone also has a text row. Mirrored like a selfie: 'Your left' / 'Your right'.
skinMap.heading: {type.section}
skinMap.label: {type.caption}

provenanceLedger.$rule: 'Where this comes from' as a receipt card: rounded surface card, hairline row dividers, sentence-case keys in a column sized to the longest key (never breaks mid-word), values in sans. Below 360dp width (or at font scale >= 1.5) the key sits above the value. Group only the text of a row; a link in the row is a sibling node after it.
provenanceLedger.title: {type.headline}
provenanceLedger.caption: {type.caption}

bottomSheet.$rule: Render every sheet inside RN Modal (or set importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants' on the screen root while open). On open, focus the title; on close, return focus to the trigger. A Close button always exists; the handle is never the only way out. Dark: sheen-edge 1dp on the top edge.
bottomSheet.title: {type.headline}

consentSheet.$rule: Warm and short: pearl hero with the face-frame bracket illustration, serif title 'Before your scan', three icon-disc rows, a 'What stays on this phone' checklist, then the approved privacy sentence as body (one TalkBack block). The 18+ checkbox lives in the sticky footer directly above the equal-weight pair.
consentSheet.$actions: button.consentPair (Start scan, Not now), side by side; stacked at font scale >= 1.3

captureGuide.$rule: Live camera in a rounded frame with four thin corner brackets and a faint oval. No face detection, no dotted mesh on a real face, no model photo. One hint pill at a time at the top. Volume keys fire the shutter.
captureGuide.$surround: The camera screen's own background (app bar, frame corners, shutter row). Dark in BOTH modes, like a viewfinder, so on-overlay white controls read on it; never inverse-surface, which is near-white in dark mode.
captureGuide.$spokenHint: Hold the phone at eye level, about an arm's length away.

processingStepper.$rule: Neutral ink only, never the accent. Drawn inside checklistCard. Done = thin circle-check, current = ring with centre dot, pending = empty ring; the ring states never resemble the UNKNOWN dashed circle. One hidden polite live region per screen announces step changes; the list itself is not a live region.

deletedStep.label: {type.bodyStrong}
deletedStep.caption: {type.caption}
deletedStep.$rule: 'Deleted from YouCam' is its own visible step with a circle-check and a timestamp stamp ('Photo deleted · 21:04').

faceFrame.$rule: Illustration (no face): rounded frame on the sheen gradient, four corner brackets in color.bracket, a faint oval, optional sparse dot grid at 30% opacity. Used on consent, processing, empty reading, result header.

checklistCard.$rule: The moodboard's analyze checklist, with our real steps: Uploading -> Analysing (YouCam HD) -> Reading results -> Deleted from YouCam. Thin circle-check when done, ring + centre dot when current, empty ring when pending. Neutral ink only.
checklistCard.label: {type.body}

readingCard.$rule: Home and result summary: icon disc (droplet) + 'Your reading' + 'Skin-type reading: Combination' + 'Scan 2 Nov · photo deleted' + chevron, then up to three band chips. One 48dp+ target; one accessibility label that reads the card in visual order. Empty: 'No reading yet' + slate pill 'Start scan'.
readingCard.title: {type.section}

focusTile.$rule: 'What this means for products' square tiles (moodboard 'Recommended Focus'). Come from the published facet map, never from Claude. Product-trait words only (Lighter textures, Fragrance-free, Hydration); never 'repair', 'treat', 'fix'.
focusTile.label: {type.label}

storeLinkOut.$base: chip row (three store chips) with one shared destination line
storeLinkOut.label: {type.button}
storeLinkOut.$rule: Store searches are a row of three chips (Flipkart / Amazon.in / Nykaa, text only) with one shared destination line under them: 'Opens a keyword search for "sunscreen" in the store app (Nykaa: browser)'. Each chip is >=48dp and its accessibility label names the destination.

copy: Ranked by fit to your readings. No paid placements.
We may earn a commission if you buy; it never changes the ranking

shareTeachingCard.$rule: Compact share tip that fits above the fold: a mini share-sheet strip of generic tiles where the highlighted tile IS the chrome-S icon labelled 'Silver Mirror', a Flipkart / Amazon / Nykaa segmented control showing one path line at a time, and a small tertiary 'Got it'.
shareTeachingCard.title: {type.section}

forecastCard.$rule: Group only the text. 'Check a sunscreen' is a sibling node after the group.

tryOnCompare.$rule: Two equal portrait cards from the same photo, a shade-name chip under each, and the fixed caption on the plain surface below. No drag slider (reads as before/after), no Save. 'Preview, not a shade guarantee' is always visible.

qrShareCard.title: {type.headline}
qrShareCard.$announce: Hidden live region only, at 25, 20, 15, 10, 5 and 1 min. The visible countdown is never a live region.

stateView.$rule: Empty, error and offline states: mark-led or face-frame plate on the sheen, one serif display line, one muted line, ONE pill action. Left-aligned text. Neutral, never red. Offline actions are disabled, not hidden.
stateView.title: {type.title}

offlineBanner.$rule: A list-row style line with a hairline under it, not a tinted slab. Polite live region when it appears.

bottomNav.$rule: Three tabs: Check · Scan · Reading. Top-level screens only; hidden on pushed details (/check result, better matches, try-on). Selection = slate pill (pearl in dark) + label weight 600 + 2.0 stroke; never colour alone. role tablist on the container; each item role tab with accessibilityState.selected. Bar bg follows the theme (never the stock white bar).
